reason: I don't touch receipts, my bookkeeper does, and she has her own way of working. The documents go missing because my guys on site never send them, and a bot sitting in the group doesn't make them send anything.
objection: Will a small Telegram bot still be around in a year? I don't want my bookkeeper rebuilding the whole system around it and then having it vanish halfway through a project.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper telling me she wants it and will run it, or the bot chasing my staff by name for the receipts that are missing before month end.
